scope: Four photo-constrained estimated rooftop masses on the north office; not whole-building or surveyed acceptance.
reviewMethod: All 11 browser screenshots viewed individually; matched major roof arrangement to previously acquired official aerial and north-office detail.

checks.finding: Two parallel strips, western return and southeast block visible within the existing parapet. Open central and perimeter roof areas remain.
Raised masses follow the slightly rotated roof edge and retain consistent positions from opposing directions; no extension into the low laboratory roof or hall.
North window grid and main height unchanged; only rooftop silhouette added.
Normal vegetation and night lighting preserve visible roof structures without changing hall roof or facade lighting.
Rooftop arrangement remains visible in base representation above the mobile panel; this is desktop viewport simulation, not a physical-phone performance test.

limitations: Dimensions, western connection and block footprint are estimates from historical imagery.
Actual equipment/room use and 2026 condition remain unconfirmed.
Existing south-facing exposed wall and other uncalibrated elevations remain outside this work package.
Personnel entrance, delivery opening and road connection remain pending.
